title: CastGroup
description: A canonical encounter INSTANCE — one NPC group placed in an encounter, plus its mutable combat state. Distinct from the NPC definition (npc.schema.json): a CastGroup is EITHER a pure reference to a library NPC (source='library', npc_ref) OR a complete inline canonical NPC (source='custom', npc) — never a hybrid. The referenced target and the inline embed are the SAME canonical NPC shape, so the combat surface loads an NPC with a single deref-or-read and NO field merge — which is what lets deriveNpc be deleted outright rather than relocated. Any per-instance tweak MATERIALIZES the group to source='custom' (resolve the base, apply the tweak, freeze) instead of patching a ref at runtime. Validated via TESTS (migrate a corpus of v3 fixtures + createCastGroup output, assert each validates here), not at runtime — the buildless JS can't validate live; it conforms by construction.
$comment: MIGRATION v3 -> v4 (encounter.cast.groups[]; bump schema_version 3 -> 4). This CHANGES shape (v2->v3 was additive, so it is NOT the template) -> NON-DESTRUCTIVE: back up / keep the v3 blob and write v4 alongside; validate the result against this schema before it replaces anything. v3 stored `source` + either `library_key` (by-ref) OR inline field-overrides, and deriveNpc merged them per-field at runtime. v4 ENDS that merge: a group is EITHER a pure ref OR a complete inline NPC. (1) source='library' with NO inline stat/skill/weapon override -> npc_ref: map library_key -> the canonical NPC id and VALIDATE it resolves in the NPC registry (a dangling key -> materialize from any inline data, else flag the group); drop the duplicated `tier` (read from the definition). (2) source='library' WITH inline overrides, AND every seed-test group (which denormalizes the full block) -> MATERIALIZE to source='custom': resolve the registry base, apply the v3 inline values, emit a complete inline canonical NPC using the SAME transform Phase 2b applies to library records (reuse it, do NOT fork); set _derived_from to the base npc_ref for provenance. Snapshot semantics are intended. (3) source='custom' (already inline) -> run the Phase-2b transform on the inline block. Normalize ONCE at migration (not at every runtime read, which is what deriveNpc did): library_key->npc_ref, vehicle_key->vehicle_ref, wounds||woundThreshold, key capitalization, and the flat stat keys meleeDefense/rangedDefense/wounds/strain -> derived.melee_defense/ranged_defense/wounds/strain (the Phase-2b derived split; strain per the tier/null rule). wounds_current/strain_current/defeated stay FLAT (recon-confirmed: combat reads/writes them via shallow Object.assign + g[field]; nesting breaks every call site) — preserve the v3 saved values.

id.description: Instance id (was generateGroupId()). Unique within the encounter.

source.description: Discriminator. 'library' = npc_ref points at a canonical NPC in the registry (pure reference, no stat overrides). 'custom' = npc holds a complete inline canonical NPC. A per-instance tweak does not patch a 'library' group — it materializes the group to 'custom'.

npc_ref.description: source='library' ONLY. Canonical NPC id, resolved against the NPC registry at load (replaces library_key, which held a raw stoogoff key). MUST resolve to a registry NPC id (referential check). Tier, characteristics, derived thresholds, skills, weapons ALL come from the resolved definition — never duplicated or overridden here; a group needing any override is 'custom' instead.

npc.description: source='custom' ONLY. A complete inline canonical NPC — the SAME schema a library entry conforms to. Holds both genuinely-custom NPCs and MATERIALIZED library NPCs (a library ref + a tweak, frozen). See _derived_from for the latter's provenance.

group_size.description: Bodies in the group (minions default 4, others 1; default derived from the definition's tier, overridable). A stored instance decision, not a definition property.

display_name.description: Optional instance-level DISPLAY name (was top-level `name`). Presentation only — the renderer prefers it over the definition's name; it is not a stat override and triggers no materialization (e.g. 'Sergeant Vatok' shown over 'Stormtrooper').

faction_id.description: Reference to a canonical Faction id (was faction_id, sourced from libraryNpc.affiliation).

vehicle_ref.description: Reference to a canonical Vehicle id if this group crews/pilots one (was vehicle_key).

wounds_current.description: MUTABLE combat state. Current wounds; null until combat initializes it from the definition's wound THRESHOLD. (Definition holds the threshold; the instance holds the current value.)

strain_current.description: MUTABLE combat state. Current strain; null until initialized from the definition's strain threshold.

_derived_from.description: source='custom' only, optional. When this custom NPC was MATERIALIZED from a library NPC (a ref + a tweak, frozen), the base npc_ref it came from — provenance only, never re-merged at runtime. null/absent for a from-scratch custom NPC.
